title: libcuflynx calibration workflow (calibration_workflow.json)
description: Ordered calibrations, and the analyses around them, whose calibrated values are merged into one model, the target. A step's kind is calibration (the default), sensitivity, reduction, emulation, identifiability, set or sweep; every kind but reduction, set and sweep names the three inputs of an ordinary run: a model (a CA module array, or a module of a module library), an obs_data file and a params_for_id file; paths are relative to this file. Run with cuflynx-calibration-workflow or libcuflynx.calibration_workflow.run_calibration_workflow. The checks that need the files and the module library (they exist, each step's model sits in the target) are in libcuflynx/calibration_workflow/resolve.py; the rest are in spec.py as well as here.

target.description: the model the calibrated values are merged into

module_library_dirs.description: module libraries, relative to this file; more can be given on the command line

external_figures.description: Scripts outside the workflow that read its results and write figures. libcuflynx never runs them: the provenance diagram draws each, with whether its files are current. A path is absolute (~ allowed) or relative to the run's output directory.

command.description: how the script is run, for the reader

from.description: the step whose results it reads, or "target" for the merged model

oneOf.description: a CA module array; its parameters file is <prefix>_parameters.json beside it

items.description: an instance of the target: a record name, or a path into a super instance (heart/lv)

select.description: instances of the workflow's module-array target, calibrated as they are in it. One instance is calibrated as its library module, placed at that instance; several (records of the target) as the module array they form, cut from the target

selection.description: a selection of the target's instances

parameters.description: its parameters file; default <prefix>_parameters.json beside it

allOf.description: "instance" is not a target key: a target names its parameter set with "parameterisation".

module_type.description: the module type (a module config entry's module_type)

library_module.description: a module of a module library: one parameterisation of one version

settings.description: user_inputs settings for the steps (a step's are merged over the workflow's, one dict level deep). The model, obs_data, params_for_id and output directories are chosen by the workflow and cannot be set.

oneOf.description: a step id; its stored distribution, as the default kind (mvnormal)

step.description: the step whose stored distribution is used (it must set store_distribution)

kind.description: how the stored samples are represented: a multivariate normal, independent normals, or a kernel density estimate, each on a scale on which the parameter bounds are unbounded

inflate.description: multiplies the distribution's variance, to temper an overconfident earlier posterior

parameters.description: only these parameters (model names in the source step), not all of them

parameter.description: the parameter, <vessel>/<parameter> as the target names it (global/<parameter> for a global)

value.description: the value it is set to

of.description: what "scale" multiplies: a calibration or set step, whose value of this parameter is used, or "inherited", the value the target gives it

units.description: its units; by default those the target or the "of" step gives it

reason.description: why it has this value: shown beside it wherever the value is reported

set_entry.description: one value set by hand: a value, or a scale of an existing value

scale.description: log spaces the points by ratio

factors.description: these multiples of the value the step's model gives it

id.description: a label for the step, unique in the file: other steps refer to it, and it names the step's output directory; not "." or ".."

kind.description: calibration: a param_id run (MCMC with store_distribution). sensitivity: sensitivity analysis (settings.sa_options). reduction: keeps the parameters a Sobol sensitivity step found most influential (sensitivity_from, reduction), for a calibration's or emulation's params_for_id_from. emulation: trains an emulator (settings.emulator_settings) for steps with emulator_from. identifiability: identifiability analysis (settings.ia_options) at the result of result_from. set: declares values or scales by hand (set), for fixed_from and the target. sweep: runs a model across chosen parameter values (sweep), feeding nothing forward. A step of any other kind than reduction, set or sweep needs model, obs_data and params_for_id (a calibration or emulation may give params_for_id_from instead).

model.description: the model this step runs on

obs_data.description: the obs_data file it is run against

params_for_id.description: the params_for_id file: what it calibrates or analyses

submodule.description: a library module in a library supermodule target: where it sits, a submodule name or a nested one as soma/i_M (soma_i_M is also read). Inferred when the module type and version occur once.

vessel.description: a library module in a module-array target: the vessel it is. Inferred when the module type and version occur once.

vessel_map.description: a module-array model: its vessel names -> the target's (a submodule path for a library target). Unmapped vessels keep their names.

fixed_from.description: calibration or set steps whose values, and the values they were given as fixed, are fixed in this step's model; this step runs after them

priors_from.description: earlier steps whose stored distributions become priors here: their parameters are calibrated again in this step, with that prior

store_distribution.description: after the fit, sample the posterior by MCMC (needs UQ_options) and store it (chain, samples, stats) for later steps and tools

on_target.description: (sweep) run on the target with every calibration's and set step's values merged as the target merges them, a later step winning; such a step names no model, fixed_from or result_from, and runs after every calibration and set step

emulator_from.description: an emulation step whose emulator this step runs on (calibration or sensitivity), with that step's model; give the same model, obs_data and params_for_id as it

result_from.description: a calibration step whose values, including those of the parameters this step analyses, this step's model is generated with (sensitivity, identifiability or sweep: the analysis is at that result)

sensitivity_from.description: a reduction step: the Sobol sensitivity step whose indices it ranks

params_for_id_from.description: a calibration or emulation step: the reduction step whose params_for_id it uses instead of its own; a step on that emulator names the same reduction

top_n.description: how many parameters to keep, highest score first

criterion.description: a parameter's score: the max or mean of its index over the outputs

reduction.description: a reduction step: which parameters to keep

set.description: a set step: the values it declares

design.description: grid: every combination. one_at_a_time: each parameter's values with the others at the model's values

outputs.description: variables recorded over time at each point

parameters.description: <vessel>/<parameter>, as a params_for_id names it, and the values it takes. Empty: one run of the protocol as the model has it

zip.description: groups of parameters that move together: the i-th point of the group takes each one's i-th value, so their value lists have one length; the design treats a group as one parameter

sweep.description: a sweep step: its points, and what each records. An obs_data gives the protocol, and its prediction items a feature per point; without one, settings give dt and sim_time

else.description: A step that is not a reduction, set or sweep names its model, obs_data and params_for_id (a calibration or emulation may take params_for_id from a reduction instead: params_for_id_from, not both).
